lines.1: 「Ms. Inori was the one who restored my memories, right?」
lines.2: 「It made me think again that there's something mysterious about her.」
lines.5: 「Hah. A teacher and her student aren't likely to make a very successful couple.」
lines.7: I cannot get that expression out of my mind.
lines.8: It isn't love at first sight.
lines.9: But that sorrowful face is burned into my memory.
lines.10: 「Tsushima, I hear you've been rather smitten with Ms. Inori lately.」
lines.11: 「Well, sort of. More curious than smitten, really.」
lines.12: Damn Crab. She went and told her.
lines.13: 「She does have a mysterious side. That intrigued me too.」
lines.14: 「So I looked into her a little. Want to hear?」
lines.16: 「Ms. Inori says she's from a village around Mount Senjo in Oeyama.」
lines.18: 「The thing is, Mount Senjo is apparently the name of the summit area. So I investigated it myself.」
lines.19: 「There was never any village there to begin with.」
lines.21: 「I didn't look any further, but there seems to be quite a story there. Be careful.」
lines.22: 「Keep this to yourself. Loose lips bring a chill, as they say.」
lines.24: 「More importantly, Princess, why are you being so helpful to me?」
lines.25: 「Well, I did something a little bad yesterday.」
lines.26: So even she feels a little guilty...
lines.27: Ms. Inori truly is wrapped in mysteries.
lines.28: 「Hey, Crab. How does 'Loose lips bring a chill' finish again?」
lines.30: 「I was an idiot to ask you.」
lines.31: 「Loose lips bring a chill autumn wind... It means that careless words invite misfortune.」
